== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of Red Squadron X-wing with the bronze errata disc, from the starwarsccg.org card lists; this file is the earliest archived copy, uploaded unchanged: [https://web.archive.org/web/20180125062122/https://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/OfficialTournamentSealedDeck-Light/large/redsquadronxwing.gif Internet Archive]. Shown on [[Red Squadron X-wing (PC Errata 2018 disc card)]].
